## About Amflow Exim Private Limited

Data last updated: 10 March 2026

Amflow Exim Private Limited is a private limited company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It specialises in accounting and financial advisory, a part of the broader professional services sector. Incorporated on 03 April 2018, the company has been in operation for over 8 years.

Registered with ROC Pune under CIN U74110PN2018PTC175785.

Capital: an authorised share capital of ₹1 Lakh and a paid-up capital of ₹1 Lakh. It is led by directors Prakanshu Singh and Abhishek Chopra.

Last AGM: 30 September 2025. Financial statements filed for year ended 31 March 2025. Office: Pune, Maharashtra.

As per the financials filed for FY 2022, the company reported a revenue of ₹17.12 Lakh, reflecting significant growth compared to the previous year.

## Our Expertise

### Comprehensive Supply Chain Solutions

We cover every step of the export-import flow, protecting your capital and ensuring your goods arrive on time and up to standard.

#### 1. Sourcing & Factory Audit

Finding a factory on Alibaba is easy. Finding a *reliable* one is hard. We do the legwork to find hidden gems in Vietnam's manufacturing belts.

##### Supplier Identification

Shortlisting manufacturers in Furniture, Textiles, Handicrafts, and Electronics based on your exact specs.

##### Thorough Factory Audits

On-site verification of business licenses, production capacity, working conditions, and social compliance.

##### Price Negotiation

Leveraging our local knowledge to get you true factory-direct prices, avoiding middleman markups.

##### Sample Prototyping

Managing the sample creation process, ensuring materials and designs meet your standards before mass production.

#### 2. On-Site Quality Control (QC)

Don't wait until the container arrives to discover defects. Our inspectors are your eyes on the factory floor.

##### DUPRO & PPI

Pre-Production and During Production Inspections to catch raw material issues and assembly errors early.

##### Pre-Shipment Inspection (PSI)

Rigorous AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) testing on finished goods, packaging, and labeling before balance payment.

##### Container Loading (CLS)

Supervising the stuffing process to ensure correct quantities, safe packing, and proper container sealing.

##### Live Video Reports

Real-time WhatsApp/WeChat video calls from the factory and comprehensive PDF reports within 24 hours.

For Int. Buyers & Local SMEs

#### 3. Outsourced Exim Dept.

Logistics and paperwork can kill a deal. We handle the bureaucratic heavy lifting so goods cross borders smoothly.

Hire our team

##### Exim Documentation

Preparation of flawless Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading, and Certificates of Origin (C/O).

##### Customs Clearance

Navigating Vietnamese customs regulations, HS code classification, and tax optimization to prevent delays.

##### Secure Payments (L/C, T/T)

Advising and reviewing Letters of Credit and drafting rock-solid international sales contracts to protect your funds.

##### Freight Booking

Securing competitive sea freight (FCL/LCL) and air freight rates via our network of local forwarders.

## How It Works

### Your Exim Flow, Simplified

1

#### Discovery & Brief

We hop on a call to understand your product specs, target pricing, MOQ, and quality standards.

2

#### Match & Audit

We identify 3-5 best-fit factories, conduct background checks, and negotiate terms.

3

#### Sample & Produce

You approve the golden sample. Production begins while we conduct mid-production inspections.

4

#### QC & Ship

Final inspection, container loading supervision, and handing over all export documents.

## Our Unfair Advantage

### Positioned at the Core of Vietnam's Northern Hub

We are headquartered in Tu Son (Bac Ninh), directly between Hanoi's business district and Hai Phong Port (the largest port in the North). This isn't just an address; it's a strategic weapon.

2-Hour Radius to Major Factories We can physically reach hundreds of wood, textile, and electronic manufacturers within hours if an emergency arises.

Direct Port Access Proximity to Hai Phong Port and Lach Huyen deep-water port ensures swift resolution of customs and loading issues.

Local Cultural Nuance We speak the language, understand the local business etiquette, and know how to negotiate with Vietnamese factory bosse
